title: Demo the dashboard to Halvorsen on Thursday
transcript:
[00:00] Gabriel: Morning. Halvorsen Freight asked to see the dashboard before they renew. They meet their board next week.
[00:10] Mei: Which parts do they care about?
[00:13] Gabriel: Late shipments by lane, and the carrier scorecard. Their ops director brought up the scorecard twice.
[00:24] Oskar: The scorecard view is new. We only finished the scoring logic last sprint.
[00:32] Mei: The designs for it are done, though. The fleet map, the scorecard, the lane breakdown.
[00:41] Gabriel: Can we show it to them this week?
[00:45] Oskar: Thursday works for me.
[00:48] Mei: Thursday's fine.
[00:50] Gabriel: Great. So Oskar demos the dashboard to Halvorsen on Thursday. I'll send the invite.
[00:58] Oskar: Sure. Can you ask them for a sample of their shipment data? It's a better demo with their own lanes.
[01:08] Gabriel: I'll ask, but their IT is slow. Don't count on it.
[01:14] Mei: I'll tidy up the scorecard screens before then. A couple of labels are still placeholders.
[01:22] Oskar: The colour scale on the lane chart is off too. Red means on time right now.
[01:30] Mei: Ha. I'll fix that as well.
[01:34] Gabriel: Should we mention the pricing change on the call?
[01:39] Mei: I'd leave pricing for the renewal call itself.
[01:44] Gabriel: Fair. I'll keep Thursday to the product.
[01:49] Oskar: How long is the slot?
[01:52] Gabriel: Forty-five minutes, with fifteen for questions.
[01:57] Oskar: OK. I'll do a dry run on Wednesday.
[02:02] Gabriel: Perfect. Thanks, all.
